title: Little Sophia doll used to map children's brains in Africa

tellings.quote: Yeah. And doll a doll called little Sophia. This ass doll. Like to make him think about STEM.

plain: A comedian, Kurt Metzger, talks about a talking doll called Little Sophia, which he says was sold as a way to get children thinking about science and technology. In his telling, the doll was used in Africa to map children's brains, which would mean children were being studied without knowing it.
